overview: demiurge is a universal, hexa-native technical-design architecture program: it drives any engineering system through one 7-verb pipeline, with each field plugged in as a manifest-only domain (single generic dispatch, no per-domain code — governance d4). Two surfaces sit on the same pipeline: a Next.js web GUI (human surface) and a hexa-native CLI (AI-agent surface). Reusable implementation is owned by the sibling hexa-lang repo — demiurge is a typed-interface consumer, never an absorber (d3).
